card.name: Separators in cardiovascular event lists
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words (or, prior) inside lists of cardiovascular events such as myocardial infarction, stroke, arrhythmia. Also fires on a few stray numbers or hyphens in dosing and trial text.

modes.label: Comma in event list
modes.description: The comma or 'or' that follows a listed cardiac event such as myocardial infarction or stroke, before the next item.
modes.example: Patients who have suffered a myocardial infarction, stroke<<,>> life-threatening arrhythmia, or coronary

modes.label: Linking word before condition
modes.description: A small word such as 'prior' or 'or' that comes before a risk condition or a kidney-function cutoff.

modes.label: Stray number or hyphen
modes.description: A digit or hyphen inside trial follow-up durations or chemical names.
modes.example: median follow up of <<5>>.4 years, cholelith
